utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I checked my toolbox and I can bring some tape and a screwdriver. I’m still looking for extra screws, too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Nell — tape and a screwdriver will definitely help. If you find those extra screws, bring them along, and I can also lend a hand with anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring the tape and screwdriver, and I’ll keep looking for the screws too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep you posted if Manny shows up. We’re in pretty good shape with the helpers and donations so far.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you, Tess. And just a reminder, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll update everyone about the Sunday community center plan and keep an eye out for Manny.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with a few small fixes if needed—just remind me of the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep track of the supplies and send you the details once they’re set. We’re aiming to start the repair drive at 10, after the tables are ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me—just let me know when the tables are ready and I’ll show up for the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: How about around 3 if that works? Please bring the tape and the spare screws, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 3 works for me—I’ll bring the tape and spare screws. I’ll check in with a few folks and help connect everyone for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—3 works for me too. Can you send me the exact drop-off time and a quick list of what still needs to be moved?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Did we get many people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’ve got a few folks so far, but I still need more helpers at the front porch this Saturday. Are you able to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can help at the front porch this Saturday. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 sounds good to me—it gives us enough time to get the tables ready and have everything set before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, 10 works for me too—just remind me where to set up, and I’ll help get things ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great—let’s set up by the school gym entrance near the tables. I’ll be there at 9 to get the sign-in sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 AM by the community center works for me. I’ll bring the work gloves and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be there. Just let me know what needs doing when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll keep it simple and let you know what needs doing when you arrive at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, but it should be on today. I’ll confirm as soon as I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any update as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep checking too and let you know as soon as I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the locations mapped out, but I still need the latest timing before I confirm anything. If you hear back on the repair drive details, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got 9 confirmed for me. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ve got the locations ready, so once the timing is set I can confirm the route. Please keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 AM by the community center with the gloves and screwdriver, and I’ll label the box and note any bulbs that aren’t working.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Rey—see you at 9 AM by the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive around the block and let you know as soon as I confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. I’m still bringing the box of light bulbs for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks around the block know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I must’ve missed it. What got added to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I brought tape, screws, and a screwdriver. We’re still on for around 3, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks for bringing those. And yes, around 3 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let’s start at 10, once the tables are ready. I’ll keep track of our supplies and note anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 10 works for me — I’ll bring the tape and spare screws. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Rey — tape and screws will help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll check in with Cleo about supplies first, then circle back with you on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know what’s short, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—I’ll talk to Cleo and then send you a quick list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Rosa — just let me know what’s needed first, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — the main thing is to help spread the word that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can also help set up when you arrive, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that, Rosa. I’ll help spread the word and I’ll pitch in with setup when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time were you thinking for the repair drive itself? I can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: 9 works well for the repair drive—I’ll let the neighbors know. Could you help set up the tables and sign-in sheet at the community center then?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9 works for me—I can be there to set up the tables and sign-in sheet at the community center. Thanks for coordinating with the neighbors!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Around 3 still works for me, but I need the exact drop-off time and a quick list of what still needs moving. If you can bring the tape and spare screws, I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the exact drop-off time and what still needs moving, then I’ll bring the tape and spare screws if that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — just send me the exact drop-off time and the updated list when you have it, and I’ll be ready around 3.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can probably bring a screwdriver if I can find one. I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces, so please remind me what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear them. If you’ve got anything to label or sort, go ahead and mark it for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and label what I can. Just send me the time when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, even if I might need a reminder or two about the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’ll remind you Saturday at the front porch, and you can jump in wherever we need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — Saturday at the front porch works for me. I’ll be there, and I’ll do my best to remember!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—let’s start with the tool table and the small fixes you can handle. I’ll keep track and send people to the next item after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll set up the tool table and handle the small fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo—thanks. I’ll keep an eye on the list and direct folks to the next item once you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to folks around the block. Let me know as soon as you confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m still waiting on the latest details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive around the block until you send the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the light bulbs ready, and I can help with whatever else you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — so we’re still on for 3 today, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 3 works for me. I’ll be there with the light bulbs and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll be there at 9 with my gloves and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Eli — that’ll be a big help. I’ll bring my toolbox and a few extra screws in case we need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — see you at 9.
